searchText: yeah man, i believe that. i always said i wanted to go into sports, it’s what i love, probably like you too. but i’ve found, there are just too many mean and nasty people in it that don’t appreciate anything. a few years back sammy palace told me, he knew what i wanted to do in sports and he wasn’t going to deter me but just to observe and watch. i didn’t know what he meant at the time, i know too well now  eric horwitz
